reason: Document B opens with a three-phase overview and defines plain terms such as outbox, lease, epoch and idempotent. author: haiku
reason: Document A is easier to follow. It gives a three-phase overview and defines its terms up front. author: sonnet

author: sonnet
reason: A opens with one model that works in both directions (the source of truth commits each write with an outbox row, makes a quick copy, then a drainer repairs what was missed, and the roles swap at the switch), and it states every step in the same compact Starts/Changes/State/If-it-fails form.
